warnings: S1 and S3 each print a short-span and a long-span section with the same RB9@0.20 bottom mesh and top bars — one entry per mark.
S2 prints no thickness; its '0.05' is a level step at the slab edge (toilet floor dropped 5 cm), kept as level_step_mm, thickness_mm null.
S4 (front step, 1.00) prints RB 12 mm. @0.15 m., top +0.15 and a 0.30 brick riser (ก่ออิฐชูขอบทำขั้นบันได); no thickness printed.

Conflict, decided: the precast-plank topping mesh is 'WIRE MESH Ø 4 @0.25 m#' on this detail but 'Wire Mesh Ø 4 mm# @0.20 m หรือเหล็ก RB Ø 6 มม. # @0.20 ม.' in the S-03 plan note. The detail sheet wins over the plan note (op01 precedence: detail > plan) → 250 recorded, flagged; the S-03 reading is kept in the note.
The precast detail is written 'พื้นสำเร็จรูป' with no mark; it is the plank marked SP on S-03 (PS in S-03's note), so element_id SP.
